basic_details.job_title: GeM Senior Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: Minimum 8 years of total professional experience, including at least 3 years of experience in any of the following: Vendor capability / compliance assessment, Quality Assurance and Certification, or Public Procurement.

salary_details.senior manager – vendor validation: Level E-4 (Contractual under Project Management Unit of GeM)
salary_details.details: The notification does not mention any additional allowances, benefits, or in-hand salary calculations.

selection_process: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates by the GeM selection committee followed by an interview.
how_to_apply: Review the official notification and ensure eligibility for the Senior Manager – Vendor Validation post.

Answer all the required application questions listed in the notification: graduation degree and specialization with year of passing, post-graduation degree and specialization with year of passing, total experience, annual current CTC, annual expected CTC, 3-years of experience details in specified domains, notice period/joining time, openness to work in Delhi, and details of anyone known in GeM.
Attach your updated resume and the answered application questions.
Forward the application and CV by email to [email protected].
Ensure the application is submitted by the stipulated last date of 9 October 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications without the application form and answers to the mandated questions will not be considered. No applications shall be entertained under any circumstances after the stipulated date of 9 October 2026. Mere fulfillment of minimum eligibility criteria does not ensure consideration for shortlisting for the interview. The GeM selection committee reserves the right to relax or extend the eligibility criteria and educational qualifications. The crucial date for determining eligibility will be the last date of receipt of applications. The contractual engagement is under the Project Management Unit (PMU) for an initial period of 5 years, extendable based on performance and organizational requirements. GeM will not entertain any correspondence regarding shortlisting decisions, and the decision of GeM will be final in all matters.

content_sections.text: Minimum 8 years of total professional experience, including at least 3 years of experience in any of the following: Vendor capability / compliance assessment, Quality Assurance and Certification, or Public Procurement.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: Bachelor’s degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Management / Economics / Commerce / Law from a recognized institution.Desirable: MBA/PGDM in Operations, Marketing, Business Analytics, Strategy. Additional qualifications/certifications in Procurement, Product Management, Quality Management, Data Analytics, Six Sigma, Project Management. Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Company Secretary (CS). Experience in Corporate Law / Company Law / Corporate Governance.

Attach your updated resume and the answered application questions. Forward the application and CV by email to [email protected] . Ensure the application is submitted by the stipulated last date of 9 October 2026.

Mere fulfillment of minimum eligibility criteria does not ensure consideration for shortlisting for the interview. The GeM selection committee reserves the right to relax or extend the eligibility criteria and educational qualifications. The crucial date for determining eligibility will be the last date of receipt of applications. The contractual engagement is under the Project Management Unit (PMU) for an initial period of 5 years, extendable based on performance and organizational requirements. GeM will not entertain any correspondence regarding shortlisting decisions, and the decision of GeM will be final in all matters.

faq.question: Q1. What is the role offered in GeM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Government eMarketplace is recruiting for the post of Senior Manager – Vendor Validation on a contractual basis under the Project Management Unit.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for GeM Senior Manager – Vendor Validation?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GeM Senior Manager – Vendor Validation?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications has been extended till 9 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Technology, Management, Economics, Commerce, or Law from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. How much professional experience is required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 8 years of total professional experience, including at least 3 years of experience in vendor capability/compliance assessment, quality assurance and certification, or public procurement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GeM Senior Manager Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by sending their completed application responses along with an updated CV via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GeM Senior Manager – Vendor Validation?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates by the GeM selection committee followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Manager – Vendor Validation post is New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual engagement under the Project Management Unit (PMU) for an initial period of 5 years, extendable based on performance and organizational requirements.
